text:
Alex: Uploaded an Nsight timeline + nvprof capture from the 8xA100 run where tail latency jumped. Captured with `—capture=timeline` and a couple custom timers around KV cache ops. TL;DR: there's a recurring ~3ms rendezvous gap right before some all-reduce ops. attaching: drive/rdw-infer/caps/1845567890_nsight.zip

Maya: Nice. Which partitioning was this? TP=4 PP=1? batch sizing? :thinking_face:

Alex: TP=2 PP=2, batch_size target=64, dynamic batching on. seq_len distribution centered at 1024 but a fat tail up to 2048. KV cache disabled for that experiment to stress cold-paths.

Simon: Quick hypothesis: handshake scheduling for small NCCL messages + kernel launch serialization. If we see many small allreduces interleaved with compute launches, the launch latency stacks.

Maya: Can you paste the nvprof marker dump for one of the spikes?

Alex: pasted snippet from nvprof (trimmed):
```
[Time] event: 0.120s kernel: compute_k  (dur 1.8ms)
[Time] event: 0.1218s ncclAllReduce_start
[Time] event: 0.1251s ncclAllReduce_end    (dur 3.3ms)  <-- long wait
[Time] event: 0.1286s compute_k2 (dur 0.7ms)
```
Notice the nccl gap aligns with a preceding small host-side sync from `kv_fetch` in our custom timers.

Simon: Do custom timers show overlap percentage? I remember the last run had ~60% comm/compute overlap, but that was with KV cache on.

Alex: Custom timers (per-iter last 200 iters): `comm_overlap=31%`, `avg_allreduce=2.9ms`, `kv_fetch_host_sync=0.8ms` spikes correlated to those iterations.

Maya: Two quick experiments to try: 1) enable prefix KV cache so fewer cold-path fetches; 2) run a microbench with aggregated message sizes to see NCCL aggregation efficiency. Could also try increasing `batch_pack_threshold` so we avoid launching tiny tensors into the ring.

Simon: Agreed. Also try switching kernel selection policy to prefer fused allreduce-friendly kernels (we have the `kernel_policy=aggr_friendly` flag). If kernel scheduling causes fragmentation of streams, that could hurt overlap.

Alex: I'll run 4 quick experiments and post results: (A) KV cache on, baseline batching; (B) KV cache on, pack threshold + policy=aggr_friendly; (C) KV cache off, microbench allreduce 64k msgs; (D) KP=aggr_friendly + NCCL_P2P=1. ETA ~2 hrs.

CI-Bot: @Alex started job rdw-infer/eval/1845567890-a (kv_cache_on, pack=64, policy=aggr_friendly).

Maya: For instrumentation, add `--emit-timeline-snippets` and increase timer resolution to 10us. Also grep for `nvtx:handshake` tags in the nsight timeline — we added those last month.

Alex: Will do. If any run reproduces the 3ms rendezvous, I'll dump a flame chart and post a collapsed stack. If we fix it with packing/policy, we should add a batching heuristic that toggles policy when seq_len tail > 1% and kv_cache_miss_rate > 0.1.

Simon: Sounds good. If packing helps, we should also add a unit microbench to CI that probes allreduce efficiency at different message coalescing thresholds to avoid regressions.

InfraBot: Note: GPU nodes used: infer-prod-08..11, driver 525.105, NCCL 2.14.3. Ensure kernel builds include `-DSTREAMS_DEBUG=0` for comparable timings.

Alex: All right kicking off experiments now. Will update thread with timings + timeline snippets. :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks — if you hit unexplained serialization, tag me and I'll run the nsight frame-level capture.

Simon: If we see persistent tokenization of small launches, we might need to alter our kernel-selection cache TTL so fused kernels persist across short rollouts.

Alex: Noted. Posting first results in ~90m.
